title: What's new in Finance: Overview (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Excise taxes improvements - multiple per item
Excise taxes - bonded locations and transfer entries
Excise taxes - ad valorem and hybrid calculation models

features.name: Multiple excise taxes per item
features.description: Users can now add multiple excise taxes to a single item instead of just one. The system includes a new excise taxes page accessible from the item card's Related menu, allowing any number of excise taxes per item.
caveats: Automatic upgrade from previous excise tax configuration required

features.name: Bonded location support for excise taxes
features.description: New feature allowing locations to be marked as bonded locations where excise duties are not calculated on inbound receipt but only when goods are released from the bonded location.
features.status_evidence_quote: Uh again, it will it will be delivered in November, but this is completely new functionality.

features.name: Transfer entry type for excise permissions
features.description: New entry type added to excise permissions to support transfer scenarios in addition to existing sales, purchase, and manufacturing entry types.

features.name: Ad valorem excise tax calculation
features.description: New ad valorem calculation model for excise taxes where duties are calculated as a percentage of taxable amount rather than per volume, quantity, or weight.
features.status_evidence_quote: So, this is what is coming in November. What else we have?

features.name: Hybrid excise tax calculation model
features.description: Combined calculation model for excise taxes that applies both specific and ad valorem components, allowing fees based on weight plus a percentage of taxable amount.
features.status_evidence_quote: So, this is what is coming in November. What else we have?
caveats: Complex calculation model for rare scenarios

features.name: Self-billing vendor-specific number series
features.description: Enhancement allowing selection of specific number series for each vendor using self-billing, with fallback to payable purchase setup if none is selected.

features.name: Self-billing PEPPOL format support
features.description: Self-billing invoices now support PEPPOL format and are integrated into the e-documents framework alongside standard invoicing.

features.name: Cross environment master data management
features.description: Functionality enabling management of master data across multiple environments, particularly useful for companies with multiple localizations requiring separate environments.

features.name: Withholding tax for employees
features.description: New capability to calculate and apply withholding taxes for employees with options for gross or net calculation, different thresholds per period and category, and multiple calculation models.
caveats: Can be used in expense agent or general journal
More functionality planned for withholding taxes

features.name: Invoicing for France GA
features.description: French e-invoicing functionality now generally available.
features.status_evidence_quote: we introduce invoicing for France. It will be in GA as well

features.name: Payment terms expansion for Australia and Great Britain
features.description: Enhanced payment terms rules for Australia and Great Britain localizations.

features.name: Intrastat reporting for Germany
features.description: New structured intrastat reporting in Germany based on updated intrastat core rules.

features.name: Fully structured address for QR invoicing in Switzerland
features.description: QR invoicing in Switzerland now supports fully structured address format.

features.name: EU BP audit file export for Germany
features.description: Ability to export EU BP files using audit file export functionality, specific to German localization.

features.name: SFT enablement for Austria and Iceland
features.description: Standard SFT functionality now enabled for Austria and Iceland localizations starting in December.
features.status_evidence_quote: we will enable SFT in Austria and Iceland starting from December. It will be standard functionality
